text:
Isabel (People Ops): Heads up - Ravi S's background check returned an alias flag. Passport shows "Ravi Sharma" but payroll form lists "Ravi Sundar". Vendor is asking for an extra ID + proof of name change/alias. Day-1 is scheduled Thu 4/11 09:00 PT.

Marta (BackgroundOps): Flag reproduced. We need either a marriage certificate / deed poll or a secondary government ID that matches payroll name. Also request a utility bill for address verification (vendor policy).

Ravi S (candidate): Hi team - I changed my last name in 2019 but passport wasn't updated; I have a scanned driver's license and a scanned deed poll PDF. I can upload both tonight.

Isabel (People Ops): perfect — please upload both to the secure intake portal by EOD tomorrow so we can clear. Note: for I-9 / right-to-work logistics, if you are UK-based we do local right-to-work check instead of US I-9. Lara, can you confirm which doc set we need?

Lara - HR Admin: Confirmed: UK hires -> right-to-work check. Vendor needs one government photo ID (passport ok) + one proof of address dated within 3 months. Deed poll is fine as proof of name change. We'll accept uploaded PDFs.

Jon (Hiring Manager): Also, Ravi mentioned the orientation time conflicts with a notice period call. Can we move Day-1 to 4/13 instead? I can free up the team.

Isabel (People Ops): propose: move Day-1 to 2024-04-13 08:30 PT / 16:30 BST. That gives vendor 48h to re-run checks after uploads. Thoughts?

Nico (Benefits): benefits note - contractors are set for stipend and stock eligibility windows change if start date moves. We need manager approval to extend stipend enrollment window from 14 days to 3 days extra.

Jon (Hiring Manager): I approve the 3-day extension for stipend enrollment.

ITShipBot: Laptop hold created under ticket `R-7890`. Standard ship ETA 3 business days after address confirmation. Customs forms may add 1-2 days for UK.

Isabel (People Ops): update checklist (paste below) — please verify items and react with :white_check_mark: when done.

```
- Candidate uploads: deed_poll.pdf, driver_license.pdf, utility_bill.pdf (within 48h)
- Vendor re-run background + right-to-work check
- Day-1 orientation moved to 2024-04-13 08:30 PT / 16:30 BST
- Stipend enrollment window extended + manager approval on file
- IT ship: confirm shipping address + customs phone number
```

Ravi S (candidate): Uploaded deed_poll.pdf and driver_license.pdf to the portal. Utility bill ETA tomorrow morning.

Marta (BackgroundOps): received docs, starting re-run now. ETA 24-48h.

Lara - HR Admin: added manager approval note to candidate record. Stipend window set to start on 2024-04-13.

ITShipBot: Please confirm shipping address for ticket R-7890 using command: `!ship confirm ADDRESS | +44-7XXXXXXXXX`

Ravi S (candidate): Address confirmed via DM to Isabel. Phone +44-7700-900123.

Isabel (People Ops): marked checklist items in our tracker. We'll keep Day-1 invite tentative until vendor clears. Will send final calendar invite on clearance.

Marta (BackgroundOps): vendor cleared right-to-work and alias match. All green.

Isabel (People Ops): great 12; final plan:

- Final start/orientation: 2024-04-13 08:30 PT / 16:30 BST
- Laptop ETA: 2024-04-11 (accounting for customs)
- Stipend enrollment link sent to Ravi, window: 3 days from start
- Records updated with deed poll proof of name change

Jon (Hiring Manager): thanks team. Ravi - excited to have you onboard.

Ravi S (candidate): Thank you everyone! See you on 4/13.
